resources.string: The saved library could not be read, so the change was not stored. A backup of the old data was kept.
This link uses http, so the video travels unencrypted. Prefer https when the server offers it.
Enter the links of two consecutive episodes. The app works out which part changes and builds the rest for you.
The part that differs is not a number, or more than one part changed
The number in the second link must be slightly larger than in the first
The changing number is too long
Add an online link and play it right here.
Tap the heart on any video to keep it here.
Everything you play shows up here.
Access to your videos is needed
To list the videos on your device by folder, the app needs permission to read them.
Only the videos you selected are visible. You can widen the selection to see everything.
No videos found on this device
The device scan did not finish
Reading the videos on this device failed. Check the permission and try again.
This device does not support picture in picture
A number between 0.1 and 6, such as 1.8
Enter a valid number between 0.1 and 6
Play landscape videos (such as 1920×1080) in landscape and portrait videos (stories, reels) in portrait
Right side volume, left side brightness; double tap to skip 15 seconds, drag sideways to seek
Looking for the next episode took too long
No network connection, so the next episode could not be checked
The next episode was not found on the server; this is probably the last one
This is the last video in this folder
This link carries no episode or season marker (such as S01E02)
When a video ends, move straight on to the next episode
There is no internet connection, or the address is unreachable
The file or link was not found
This container or codec is not supported on your device
This content is DRM protected and cannot be played
Pick a subtitle file from storage
That subtitle file could not be read
No subtitle was found for this video
A positive number shows the subtitle later, a negative one shows it earlier.
For subtitles embedded in the file, only a delay (a positive number) can be applied.
Choose the language of the interface. \"System\" follows your device setting.
\"Automatic\" follows the language: right to left for Persian, left to right for English.
Walk through the slides and set the language and subtitle colours once more.
A player for online links and for the videos already on your phone, with full control over subtitles. The next few slides set the app up exactly the way you like it.
The whole interface switches immediately. You can change this later in Settings.
Persian reads right to left and English left to right. \"Automatic\" picks the right one for you; override it only if you prefer the other.
Add any direct link (mp4, mkv, m3u8, mpd) and play it straight away. Advanced mode learns the numbering of a series from two consecutive links and builds the following episodes for you.
Your local videos are grouped by folder, with thumbnails, duration, size and a resume point. Only the read permission for videos is used.
Double tap to skip 15 seconds, drag sideways to seek, drag up and down for volume and brightness
Pick the text colour. The preview below updates as you choose.
A background box makes subtitles readable over bright scenes. Pick the one that suits you; you can fine tune size and position later.
Every screen has a question mark button that explains each icon and option. You can reopen this tour any time from Settings.
Opens the dialog where you enter a name and a direct video address. Supported schemes are http, https, rtsp, content and file.
\"All\" is sorted by the date you added the video, \"Favourites\" shows what you starred, and \"Recent\" is sorted by the last time you played something.
Plays the video and resumes at the saved position. For a series it resumes at the episode you were last watching.
Adds the video to favourites or removes it. A filled heart means it is already there.
Clears the saved position so the video starts from the beginning. It only appears once there is progress to clear.
Removes the item from the library after a confirmation. Nothing is downloaded, so nothing is deleted from the server.
Give the links of two consecutive episodes. The app finds the number that changes and the step between them, then builds the next episodes itself and shows a preview before you save.
Needed to list local videos. On Android 14 and later you can share only some videos; that partial state is supported and can be widened at any time.
Videos are grouped by the folder they live in, with the number of items and total duration. Two folders with the same name stay separate.
Filters by file name inside the folder you opened.
Rescans the device, which is useful after downloading or deleting a video.
Returns from a folder to the folder list. The system Back button does the same.
When a card shows a resume time, playback continues from exactly that point.
Leaves full screen first; if you are already windowed it closes the player and saves your position.
Plays the next item. For device videos it moves to the next file in the same folder; for links it moves to the next episode and the spinner means the server is being checked.
Cycles between Fit (whole image), Zoom (fills the screen and crops) and Stretch (fills the screen and distorts).
Shrinks the video into a floating window so you can use other apps. Leaving the app while playing does the same automatically.
Hides the system bars. Swipe from the edge to bring them back temporarily.
Opens subtitle settings: choose a track, load a file, adjust the timing and change the appearance.
Playback speed, aspect ratio, auto rotation, swipe controls and automatic next episode.

Drag vertically on the right half for volume and on the left half for brightness. Drag sideways to scrub the video, double tap the right or left side to jump 15 seconds, and single tap to show or hide the controls.
Pick a preset or type any value between 0.1 and 6 and press Apply.
Landscape videos rotate to landscape and portrait videos stay portrait, based on the real aspect ratio of the file.
When a video ends, the next episode or the next file in the folder starts automatically.
The master switch. When it is off no subtitle is drawn, even if a track is loaded.
Shifts the subtitle in steps of 0.1 and 0.5 seconds. A positive value shows it later, a negative one earlier. For subtitles embedded in the video only a delay can be applied.
Lists the subtitles found next to the video and the tracks embedded in the file, plus an option to turn subtitles off. Your choice survives episode changes.
Loads an SRT or VTT file from storage. Access to the file is kept, so it still works after a restart.
The first row is the text colour, the second the colour of the box behind it. The preview above shows the result immediately.
The first slider sets the text size, the second how far the subtitle sits from the bottom of the screen.
Bold thickens the text; the outline adds a dark shadow that keeps it readable over bright scenes.
Switches the interface between Persian and English without restarting the app. \"System\" follows the device language.
Sets whether the layout runs right to left or left to right. \"Automatic\" derives it from the chosen language.
Replays the first run slides so you can set the language and the subtitle colours again.
